wagon.title: Wagon search

meta.title: Where is the wagon · YukSaroy
meta.description: Enter a wagon number: its last known location, which station it is at, loaded or empty.

wagon.lead: Enter a wagon number: its last known location, which station it is at, loaded or empty.
wagon.label: Wagon numbers
wagon.hint: One number per line or separated by commas, up to 20. Each has 7 or 8 digits.
wagon.tooMany: At most {n} numbers are taken, the rest are dropped.
wagon.costNote: Each number counts as a separate search.
wagon.freeRepeat: Searching a found wagon again within 6 hours is free.
wagon.notEnoughFree: You entered {n} numbers and have {left} free searches. The rest need a subscription.
wagon.guest: Sign in to search. The first search is free.
wagon.subscribe: Your free search is used up. Unlimited searches need a subscription.
wagon.notFound: Wagon {no} was not found. Check the number and try again.

errors.WAGON_NO_INVALID: The number must have 7 or 8 digits.
errors.WAGON_NOT_CONFIGURED: Wagon search is not working yet. It will be available soon.
errors.WAGON_UPSTREAM: The search did not go through. Try again in a little while.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. You can continue in an hour.
